name: Claude Code Usage Minimal
description: Shows Claude Code's 5-hour and 7-day usage limits as a single tile in the Quick Settings menu, next to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth — click it to expand full details (percentages, reset countdowns). Reads the existing login credentials from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (the same file the Claude Code CLI uses), so there is nothing extra to sign in to. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
